Rules: every item cites >=2 source note paths from the candidates (field "sources", exact paths); every item has a one-sentence plain-language "pitch" and a "why_now" line grounded in recency or cluster growth; lanes are "content" (could become a post/newsletter/video), "system" (an improvement to the AI system itself), "health" (archive-quality observation). Quality over quantity — return only items genuinely worth the principal's attention; zero items in a lane is a valid answer. Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"items":[{"lane","title","pitch","why_now","sources",["suggested_format"],["recommendation"],["target_surface"]}]}
